name: OmniBehavior
summary: 用于长时、跨场景人类行为模拟的真实用户交互轨迹数据集，提供中英文版本。
summaryEn: A real-user interaction-trace dataset for long-horizon, cross-scenario human behavior simulation, released in Chinese and English.
scale: Long-horizon heterogeneous behavior traces from multiple usage scenarios
scaleZh: 来自多种使用场景的长时异构行为轨迹
organizations: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
organizationsZh: 中国科学院计算技术研究所
access: Full bilingual dataset available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 完整中英文数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 记录跨应用长期行为状态转移的真实交互轨迹数据
verdictEn: Real interaction trajectories capturing long-term behavioral transitions across applications
wmNote: 可用于用户行为世界模型和长时序动作预测，但需遵守隐私与非商业条款。
wmNoteEn: Supports user-behavior world models and long-horizon action prediction, subject to privacy and noncommercial terms.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2604.08362] Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces
evidence.statement: Real long-horizon cross-scenario human behavior traces are used for an explicit predictive simulation benchmark; behavioral events are not physical motor controls.
